title: AWKUM Department of Microbiology Secures Patent for Innovative High-Throughput Cellulose-Degrading Strain Selection Method
text:
Research & Innovation

AWKUM Department of Microbiology Secures Patent for Innovative Research Method

The
Department of Microbiology, Abdul Wali Khan University
Mardan (AWKUM)
, is pleased to announce a significant
research achievement with the grant of a patent for an innovative
method in microbial screening and biotechnology.

Patent No. 211008 (679/2021)

“Development of Innovative High Throughput Method for the
Selection of High Cellulose-Degrading Strains”

Inventors

Prof. Dr. Zia Ur Rahman

Supervisor

Ms. Ayesha Muhammad

PhD Scholar

Research Significance

The patented method offers a rapid and efficient approach for
screening and selecting microbial strains with high
cellulose-degrading capacity. It has potential applications in
biotechnology, industrial research, and sustainable waste
utilization.

The Department congratulates the inventors on this remarkable
achievement and reaffirms its commitment to fostering innovation,
scientific excellence, and applied research.

DEPARTMENT OF MICROBIOLOGY | ABDUL WALI KHAN UNIVERSITY MARDAN
